policy: A claim is publishable only at its declared evidence tier and scope. Provisional evidence never upgrades a blocked strict claim.

claims.claim: The validation-calibrated compact Sentinel-1 model has hard Dice 0.9036 and hard IoU 0.8242 on the 2024 one-AOI RGI-derived silver test.
claims.scope: Ile Alatau one-AOI temporal test; patch-level aggregate

claims.claim: In an 18-glacier post-hoc RGI pseudo-label diagnostic, Sentinel-1 improves mean hard IoU by 0.0257 while reducing mean recall by 0.1413.
claims.scope: Non-independent provisional paired diagnostic; not a holdout

claims.claim: The current S2+terrain model does not demonstrate external-geography generalisation in the automatic 2024 stress test.
claims.scope: Nine-glacier broad candidate region; RGI pseudo-label stress test
Requires two independent annotators and adjudication
Requires an authoritative regional boundary and adjudicated external labels

claims.claim: Operational GLOF warning or calibrated event probability
claims.scope: Requires source-reviewed event/control cohorts and operational validation

claims.claim: A validated 2000-2020 glacier-loss trend or 2050 area forecast
claims.scope: Current strict trend is statistically insignificant and historical methods are not uniform
